messages:
Maria K.: Heads-up — perf-bot flagged a ~22% p99 regression after the microbatch window tweak on canary. Noticed during kv-hot traffic trace.
perf-bot: [ALERT] p99 +22% on model-bridge-1 (78ms -> 95ms). Canary pool: rbw-canary-3. Links: https://perf.internal/trace/abc123
AJ: which rollout exactly? canary only or did this hit prod?
Maria K.: canary only, started at 2030123300. Config: coalesce_delay_ms=12, jitter_pct=0.25, microbatch_ms=12 (was 6).
Leo C.: did kernel selector flip around the same time? we saw kernel A->B jumps cause regressions previously when seq_len distribution shifted.
Sasha R.: quick check of profiler for the same timeframe: kernel_selector changed to matmul_fused_v2 for a subset of requests when seq_len > 256. KV hit rate dipped in same window.
Sasha R.: ```
kernel_selector: chosen_kernel=matmul_fused_v2
seq_len: 512
latency_ms: 94.3
kv_hit_rate: 0.72
```
Devon P.: KV miss rate spiked ~18% concurrent with the rollout. Could be microbatch interval increasing causing different cache priming (batches form with different prefixes).
AJ: also saw token batch size variance grow — more long-tail batches with bigger token counts after coalesce_delay grew. that inflates tail latency.
Maria K.: p50 looks stable, memory unchanged, but p99 moved. no OOMs. CPU on the host is steady.
Leo C.: immediate mitigation: revert jitter_pct to 0.1 and microbatch_ms back to 8 on canary; run an AB where kernel_selector is pinned to the previous kernel to see if perf improves.
Sasha R.: I'll run an offline arrival-trace sim to measure token-budget distribution and coalesce wait times. ETA ~2h.
Devon P.: can we add a short-term runtime guard: prevent kernel flip for a model until kv-hit stabilizes for N seconds? also add an opt-in pin-per-model flag.
AJ: yes and add metrics: per-kernel p99/p95 trends, kv-miss-rate-by-batch-size, and coalesce_wait_histogram so we can correlate.
Maria K.: created INF-3421 to track rollback + metrics + kernel-pin experiments. assigning to @Sasha R. https://redwood.internal/ticket/INF-3421
perf-bot: Canary rollback scheduled in 30m if p99 delta > +10% persists.
Leo C.: :thumbsup: let's be careful with jitter increases — they can change batching topology and unintentionally flip kernel selection surface.
AJ: note for postmortem: capture sample traces showing kernel selection reason (seq len, batch shape) + kv cache index snapshots.
Sasha R.: will attach sim results + before/after kernel traces to INF-3421 when done.
Maria K.: thanks team — if rollback doesn't hit, we'll manually revert the canary and block the broader rollout until we have kernel-stability gated.
